[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: Agroverse Shop Updates
  
  Updates to the Agroverse shop:
  
  NEW EXPERIENCES ADDED
  Added two seasonal experiences to the Pacific West Coast journey where cacao is offered:
  
  • Slab City & Salvation Mountain - The Last Free Place in America
    https://agroverse.shop/cacao-journeys/pacific-west-coast-path/experiences/slab-city-salvation-mountain/index.html
  
  • Winter Desert Gatherings - Quartzite, Salton Sea & Joshua Tree
    https://agroverse.shop/cacao-journeys/pacific-west-coast-path/experiences/winter-desert-gatherings/index.html
  
  These gatherings (Tribe Boheme, Van Aid, SchooliePalooza, Bombay Beach Binnelie, Boondockers bash, Quartzite gem show, Rubber Tramp Rendezvous) occur during winter season (Thanksgiving through end of winter) and are now part of the journey map.
  
  TASTE PROFILE VISUALIZATIONS
  Added interactive taste profile charts to shipment pages. The inclusion of these taste graphs was inspired by noticing them on one of the cacao brands that Kirsten shared. Process:
  
  1. Took photos of taste profile sheets from CIC (Cacao Innovation Center)
  2. Used Grok to generate a detailed prompt
  3. Used that prompt with Cursor AI to generate the code
  4. Embedded interactive D3.js charts on each shipment page
  
  Taste profiles available on:
  https://agroverse.shop/shipments/agl4/index.html
  https://agroverse.shop/shipments/agl6/index.html
  https://agroverse.shop/shipments/agl8/index.html
  
  COMMUNITY COLLABORATION
  Discussed taste profiling with Matheus. Since taste is subjective, we don't need to pay CIC for this. We have a community of chocolate makers and chocolatiers in San Francisco who can be involved in the process, making it more authentic and community-driven.
  
  THOUGHTS ON AI & WEB EVOLUTION
  Observations on web evolution:
  
  • Web 1.0 (Geocities era) - Rich, handcrafted pages, complex ecosystem
  • Web 1.5 (MySpace) - Mix of handcrafted and templated
  • Web 2.0 (Facebook) - Everything templatized for scale
  • Web 3.0 (AI era) - AI could handcraft pages, bringing back Web 1.0 richness without the heavy human lifting... the only question is a site fully ran based on this paradigm can it be scalable
  
  Experimenting with AI as a creative partner to build unique, handcrafted experiences at scale. The taste profile charts are an example - each tailored to the specific shipment without manually coding every one.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 400.00
- Attached Filename: None
- Destination Contribution File Location: No file attached
